Two different things sit behind the old "Liveübertragungen" idea, and **only one of them is
handled**:

- a **public viewing at a venue** is already imported and typed `SCREENING` (Lido, Astra) ✅
- an **online-only livestream** has no venue in the sense the model assumes, and no place to put a
  stream URL ❓

Probably a **no** for a Berlin-venue discovery app — the whole product premise is places you can go.
But it is worth a line in [EVENT_SCOPE.md](../../docs/EVENT_SCOPE.md) either way, so it stops being
rediscovered every few months and re-argued from scratch.

Sport stays out regardless (EVENT_SCOPE.md §5).
